verdict.rationale: Floot is a platform with an official remote MCP server, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows Floot issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens for an agent. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: OAuth sign-in for end users of the apps Floot builds, and a secure browser dialog for entering third-party API keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
